ingredients: Important information Safety Information For external use only. Individual intolerance to certain components of the product is possible; it is advised to carefully review the ingredient list before using the product. It is recommended to consult with a dermatologist before using the product. Avoid direct contact with eyes. If contact occurs, rinse thoroughly with water. Do not apply the cream around the eye area. Keep out of reach of children. Discontinue use if you experience redness or irritation. Ingredients Purified Water, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Cocos Nucifera (Coconut) Oil, Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil, Aloe Barbadensis (Aloe Vera) Gel, Stearyl Alcohol, Stearic Acid, Isopropyl Myristate, Retinol, Hydrolyzed Marine Collagen, Hyaluronic Acid, Acrylates/Steareth-20 Methacrylate Copolymer, Phenoxyethanol, Caprylyl Glycol, Potassium Sorbate, Imidazolidinyl Urea, EDTA, Carbomer, Persea Gratissima (Avocado) Oil, Organic Matricaria Recutita (Chamomile) Flower Extract, Tocopheryl Acetate (Vitamin E). Directions Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Apply daily a small amount of the cream to clean & dry skin, gently massaging in circular motions until fully absorbed. Use consistently for better results. Always follow with SPF 30+ during the day, as retinol can increase sun sensitivity. Perform a patch test by applying a small amount of the cream to a discreet area (like the inner arm or behind the ear) to check for any skin reaction. If you have sensitive or dry skin, start using the cream 1-2 times a week to help your skin adjust to the retinol.
key_features: Nourishing Face Moisturizer - Enhance your anti-aging skincare routine with this moisturizing face cream and facial moisturizer, designed to help your skin feel smooth and refreshed. Collagen supports the look of skin's flexibility while promoting a visibly firmer texture for both face and neck. Enjoy a youthful glow with a gentle solution that provides enduring hydration and care, ideal as a hydrating face moisturizer.

Advanced Retinol Face Cream - Formulated with a balanced concentration of retinol, this moisturizer promotes a renewed and smoother, refreshed appearance. Hyaluronic acid complements retinol to help maintain hydration, leaving skin feeling soft and nourished without tightness. This product complements your collection of facial skin care products and daily beauty products.

Expertly Formulated, Rigorously Tested - SimplyVital guarantees exceptional quality in each jar. We carefully select effective yet gentle components to create potent formulas, ensuring your skin gets the attention it deserves while enhancing your natural elegance. Also effective as a facial firming cream and supportive of visibly neck firming and tightening when used daily on targeted areas.

Comprehensive Skincare for All - Designed for both men and women, this cream also serves as a mens face moisturizer and face moisturizer for men, offering flexibility in any routine. It may be used in place of visible skin firming and tightening lotion or alternated with it, making it a smart addition to your skincare routine.

How to Use - Apply a small amount to clean, dry skin, massaging until absorbed. Start 1-2 times a week for sensitive skin, then increase as needed. Use daily for optimal results. Always apply SPF 30+ during the day, as retinol may heighten sun sensitivity. Perform a patch test before initial use. Discontinue use if irritation occurs. Individual sensitivity to components is possible.
